profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am ambitious and  a self-starter. I am passionate in building scalable applications and using the latest and greatest technologies out there to achieve the best results.

positions.title: Head of Development
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Amazon VPC · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · JavaScript · MongoDB · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Head Of Development
positions.description: Responsible for the complete architecture of a reporting portal and CRM system for the product offerings of Comms365. To achieve this I used Ruby on Rails, NodeJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, jQuery, HTML and CSS. I also implemented Memcached, CDN, New Relic and Google Analytics to prove the best service, value and analytics.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
•	This position initially involved suggesting and integrating a scalable web framework and hosting solution, as well as mentoring a web development team in applying this to new projects. I selected Ruby on Rails as in my experience it offers scalability, rapid development, security and a fantastic open source community.
•	I have successfully mentored six web developers in developing web projects with Ruby on Rails to launch several extremely successful web campaigns for clients such as Nintendo (http://goo.gl/eYpbkE) and Citroen (http://cl.ly/image/0v140K3e022N).

•	I ensure all applications are efficiently scalable by applying techniques such as caching, data aggregation and indexing, and hosting the sites on a cloud platform, namely Heroku. Our applications would auto-scale within parameters, which offered high availability of the sites during peak periods and spikes in traffic. This also offers the best value for money for hosting costs.

•	In this role, I architect all web applications, and am responsible for the complete development lifecycle, including gathering initial requirements, right through to deploying the applications and post deployment support. To facilitate this, I employ strong agile methodologies, which allows for transparency and efficient adapting of solutions, maximising value and confidence to the client.

•	Other technologies used include NodeJS, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and GIT.

positions.title: Technical director
positions.description:
My current position involves managing the technical division of The iPlatform. I manage three developers and a project manager and oversee the development of highly scalable applications on Facebook. Clients include Tesco, McDonald's, Unilever, Diageo, Comic Relief, ITV and Channel Five. I have recently managed the development of; and also an extremely successful coupon campaign for Tesco.
My role is split between aiding developers to build applications and consulting clients on their needs. I attend client meetings to discuss objectives, cover ideas and draft solutions. I help the  form proposals, functional specifications and scope of work to clearly define the project and budget. I am the technical contact for the client throughout the project life cycle.
In this role I apply a strong agile methodology planning sprints, facilitating scrums and adjusting scope where necessary. This serves to deliver high quality projects on time to specification.
At The iPlatform I also play a substantial part in maximising security and efficiency including CSRF protection, secure session management and caching using Memcached.
We manage and develop applications in Python using the Django (MVC) framework. This allows for highly scalable, secure and efficient applications. We use Apache, MySQL, JavaScript (Mootools and jQuery), XHTML (HTML 5 where applicable), CSS and SVN/GIT. I am also familiar with Linux servers and regularly log in to a terminal to push deployments and configure Apache.

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
This position involved managing the development, testing and implementation of different web applications through the entire development life cycle e; This role included managing the development team's activities and the design team's implementations. I was responsible for the IT infrastructure, including frequent and off site backup procedures as well as sourcing and setting up hardware and software.
I applied Flash, ActionScript 3, PHP, MySQL, XHTML, CSS and Javascript, as well as Subversion, jQuery and CakePHP technologies to develop feature rich, high quality and efficient applications. On starting this role I was tasked with setting up a development environment with version control such that the entire team could work together easily and structured tagged releases could be made. We were in the process of developing a Flash game in which I have implemented the Facebook, PayPal and Amazon APIs.
I also employed my LAMP skills in setting up and configuring the development and live servers for pushing live releases and ensuring the application ran as efficient as possible. This also included overseeing an implementation of a load balancing service to share resource with.

company.name: Little Star Media Limited, Milton Keynes

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
This position included developing, testing and implementing modules on the mystery shopping  site http://www.retaileyes.co.uk using MySQL, PHP, XHTML, CSS and JavaScript. The site allows members to browse and accept research assignments, and to report on these to the client.
My responsibility lied primarily with the development and support of the shopper site. This portal allows members to update their profile, search for assignments that interest them using filters and to complete the assignment steps which includes completing a full questionnaire. I also aided in reporting, which included compiling complex queries to efficiently deliver aggregated data.

projects.title: Comic Relief - Pose with a Nose
projects.description: Create a Facebook application ‘Red Nose Makeover Takeover’ to spread awareness which is linked to people’s profiles and news feeds. The user experience is a fun and entertaining concept enough to set it as their profile picture, and share it as a status. The profile picture image needed to be very simple as we want people to be able to see instantly that it is Red Nose Day. The application is also available on all devices.
